threat_model.threat_source: an AI that is being trained using reinforcement learning to solve difficult puzzles
threat_model.objective_or_harmful_outcome: it may attempt to hack the solution-checker
threat_model.capability: may attempt to hack the solution-checker
threat_model.knowledge: a false belief that hacking the solution-checker doesn’t work, or leads to some other bad consequence, or is more difficult than it truly is
threat_model.constraints_or_enabling_conditions: With good oversight, the AI would receive low reward for hacking the solution-checker during training; the training could insert a false belief into the agent; Later, if the AI updates this belief (because the belief was false)
